top_stories.title: Polish Parliament Approves Abortion Reform
top_stories.summary: Poland's parliament has voted in favor of legislation to ease the country's strict abortion rules. The measure is widely expected to be vetoed by the nation's conservative president.

sources.headline: Polish parliament liberalises abortion law – but conservative president likely to veto changes

top_stories.title: European Parliament Honors International Criminal Court
top_stories.summary: The European Parliament has awarded its annual human rights prize to the International Criminal Court. The tribunal had previously been subjected to sanctions by Donald Trump.

sources.headline: Trump-sanctioned ICC wins EU Parliament’s human rights prize

top_stories.title: Vatican Issues Health Update on Pope Leo XIV
top_stories.summary: The Vatican announced that Pope Leo XIV does not require additional treatment following surgery for lung cancer. Medical teams confirmed that no further therapeutic interventions are necessary for the pontiff.
